import re

def venmo_login():
    venmo_pw = [a for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
    resp = apis.venmo.login(username='alexander-ridd@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
    return resp['access_token']

venmo_token = venmo_login()
print('venmo access_token length', len(venmo_token))

phone_people = {
    'Paul': 'paul_mill@gmail.com',
    'Robert': 'robertmartinez@gmail.com',
    'Gina': 'gina-ritter@gmail.com',
    'Cesar': 'ce-maldonado@gmail.com',
    'Cheryl': 'cheweber@gmail.com',
    'Bradley': 'bradley_ball@gmail.com',
    'Carl': 'carbrown@gmail.com'
}

# resolve via venmo.search_users by email (paginate fully)
resolved = {}
for name, email in phone_people.items():
    all_results = []
    i=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        print('search_users for', name, 'email', email, 'page', i, 'count', len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        all_results.extend(res)
        i+=1
    # print returned emails for inspection
    returned_emails = [(r.get('first_name'), r.get('last_name'), r.get('email')) for r in all_results]
    print('returned (first,last,email) count', len(returned_emails))
    # exact match on email
    exact = [r for r in all_results if (r.get('email') or '').lower() == email.lower()]
    print('exact match count', len(exact))
    print('exact candidates', [(r.get('first_name'), r.get('last_name'), r.get('email')) for r in exact])
    resolved[name] = exact

print('resolution summary:')
for name, ex in resolved.items():
    print(name, 'num_exact', len(ex))

import re, pandas as pd

# Re-fetch Athens Expense Bookkeeping note content for correctness
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
print('Athens note content:\n', content)

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if '=>' in ln]
print('lines to parse:', lines)

# Build operations from note
ops = []
for ln in lines:
    # Examples:
    # 'I owe Paul => $105'
    # 'Robert owes me => $143'
    m1 = re.match(r'^I owe\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*$', ln)
    m2 = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z]+)\s+owes me\s+=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*$', ln)
    if m1:
        name = m1.group(1)
        amt = float(m1.group(2))
        ops.append({'person': name, 'direction': 'send', 'amount': amt})
    elif m2:
        name = m2.group(1)
        amt = float(m2.group(2))
        ops.append({'person': name, 'direction': 'request', 'amount': amt})
    else:
        print('Unparsed line:', ln)

print('Parsed ops:', ops)

# Map to resolved Venmo emails (via phone contacts -> exact email)
# Use venmo resolved matches computed earlier (resolved dict)
for op in ops:
    name = op['person']
    ex = resolved.get(name, [])
    if len(ex) != 1:
        op['resolved_candidates'] = len(ex)
    op['venmo_email'] = ex[0]['email'] if len(ex)==1 else None

# Add required note
for op in ops:
    op['description'] = 'For Athens trip'

# Sort for stable ordering
ops_sorted = sorted(ops, key=lambda x: x['person'])

# Print identity resolution table

# Helper to compare floats

def amounts_equal(a,b,eps=1e-6):
    return abs(a-b) <= eps

def find_matching_sent_transactions(email, amount, description):
    matches=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=email, direction='sent', min_amount=amount, max_amount=amount, page_index=i, page_limit=20, sort_by=None)
        print('sent tx search email', email, 'page', i, 'count', len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        for t in res:
            if t.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower()==email.lower() and amounts_equal(t.get('amount',0.0), amount) and t.get('description','')==description:
                matches.append(t)
        i+=1
    return matches

def find_matching_received_transactions(email, amount, description):
    matches=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=email, direction='received', min_amount=amount, max_amount=amount, page_index=i, page_limit=20, sort_by=None)
        print('received tx search email', email, 'page', i, 'count', len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        for t in res:
            if t.get('sender',{}).get('email','').lower()==email.lower() and amounts_equal(t.get('amount',0.0), amount) and t.get('description','')==description:
                matches.append(t)
        i+=1
    return matches

def find_matching_sent_payment_requests(email, amount, description):
    # Payment requests we have sent to others
    matches=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        print('sent pr search email', email, 'page', i, 'count', len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        for pr in res:
            if pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower()==email.lower() and amounts_equal(pr.get('amount',0.0), amount) and pr.get('description','')==description:
                # infer status: approved_at/denied_at
                approved_at = pr.get('approved_at')
                denied_at = pr.get('denied_at')
                status = 'pending'
                if approved_at:
                    status='approved'
                if denied_at:
                    status='denied'
                matches.append((pr,status))
        i+=1
    return matches
